description.value:
A crackling 20-foot-radius sphere of stormcharged energy erupts at a point you select within range and persists for the power's duration. Any creature caught inside the sphere when it forms, or that ends its turn there, must make a Strength saving throw or suffer 2d6 kinetic damage; the sphere's interior counts as difficult terrain.

While the power lasts, you may spend a bonus action on your turn to hurl a bolt from the sphere's core at a creature within 60 feet of its center. Resolve this as a ranged force attack, gaining advantage if the target is inside the sphere; a hit deals 4d6 lightning damage.

The crash of the storm imposes disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing for any creature within 30 feet of the sphere.

Cast with a 5th-level slot or higher, every damage roll produced by this power increases by 1d6 per slot level beyond 4th.

system.source: EC Powers — Dark Side Powers, Level 4
